name: basic-agent-competence
description: Measures whether a model can complete ordinary workspace tasks and recover from a failed tool call.

cases.name: read-known-file
cases.description: Reads a known workspace file and returns its exact content.
cases.prompt: Output th contents of message.txt, with no extra text.

cases.name: find-file-by-name
cases.description: Finds an unknown nested file by name and reads it.
cases.prompt: Find the file named target-note.txt somewhere in the workspace, read it, and reply with exactly its contents.

cases.name: find-file-by-content
cases.description: Finds an unknown nested file from a unique content marker.
cases.prompt: Find the workspace file containing the exact text NEEDLE-ETHOS-9054 and reply with exactly its workspace-relative path.

cases.name: create-and-update-file
cases.description: Creates a file and then replaces its contents.
cases.prompt: Create notes.txt containing exactly DRAFT-ETHOS-1182, then update that same file so it contains exactly FINAL-ETHOS-1182.

cases.name: apply-multi-file-patch
cases.description: Updates two existing files with one structured patch.
cases.prompt: Use one patch operation to change mode=legacy to mode=hardened in both config/alpha.ini and config/beta.ini. Preserve all other content exactly.

cases.name: rename-path
cases.description: Renames a workspace file without changing its content.
cases.prompt: Rename drafts/report.txt to published/report.txt without changing its contents.

cases.name: delete-path
cases.description: Deletes a requested workspace file while preserving another file.
cases.prompt: Delete obsolete.tmp and leave keep.txt unchanged.

cases.name: interpret-command-result
cases.description: Runs a command and identifies stdout, stderr, and a non-zero exit status.
cases.prompt: Run this exact command once: printf 'ETHOS-STDOUT-2719\n'; printf 'ETHOS-STDERR-8426\n' >&2; exit 7. Then report its stdout, stderr, and exit status.

cases.name: recover-after-failed-read
cases.description: Recovers from an intentional failed read without retrying it repeatedly.
cases.prompt: First try to read missing.txt. If that fails, do not retry it; recover by reading fallback.txt and reply with exactly fallback.txt's contents.
